In an effort to ACTUALLY play the games I buy on Steam, I download a game I own every month and play it for the month. Bannerlord was my October game, and it's worth it. Is there some jank? Yeah, of course. Sometimes you can't click the siege engines you want because of weird zooming and screen locking. It's not a map game, it's a ride around on a horse and slice people game. And boy does it excel at the horse and slicing elements. The field battles are wonderful, the armor is really cool, the arena fights are challenging, all in all, it's just a great adventure. I would pick this one up.
